name: No foreign dissemination
desc: Information may not be disseminated in any form to foreign governments, foreign nationals, foreign or international organizations, or non-US citizens.

name: Federal employees only
desc: Dissemination authorized only to (1) employees of United States Government executive branch departments and agencies, or (2) armed forces personnel of the United States or Active Guard and Reserve.

name: Federal employees and contractors only
desc: Dissemination authorized only to (1) employees of United States Government executive branch departments and agencies, (2) armed forces personnel of the United States or Active Guard and Reserve, or (3) individuals or employers who enter into a contract with the United States to perform a specific job, supply labor and materials, or for the sale of products and services, so long as dissemination is in furtherance of that contractual purpose.

name: No dissemination to contractors
desc: No dissemination authorized to individuals or employers who enter into a contract with the United States. Intended for use when dissemination is not permitted to Federal contractors, but permits dissemination to state, local, or tribal employees.

name: Dissemination list controlled
desc: Dissemination authorized only to those individuals, organizations, or entities included on an accompanying dissemination list. Use of this control supersedes other limited dissemination controls, but cannot supersede dissemination stipulated in law, Federal regulation, or Government-wide policy.

name: Authorized for release to certain nationals only
desc: Information has been predetermined by the designating agency to be releasable or has been released only to the specific foreign country(ies)/international organization(s) indicated, through established foreign disclosure procedures and channels. USA must always appear first, followed by trigraph country codes in alphabetical order, followed by tetragraph codes in alphabetical order.

name: Display only
desc: Information is authorized for disclosure to a foreign recipient but without providing the foreign recipient with a physical copy for retention (regardless of medium), to the foreign country(ies)/international organization(s) indicated. USA must always appear first, followed by trigraph country codes in alphabetical order, followed by tetragraph codes in alphabetical order.

name: Attorney-client
desc: Dissemination of information protected by the attorney-client privilege beyond the attorney, the attorney’s agents, or the client is prohibited by this marking. For use only with the Legal Privilege category.

name: Attorney work product
desc: Dissemination of information protected by the attorney work product privilege beyond the attorney, the attorney’s agents, or the client is prohibited by this marking unless specifically permitted by the overseeing attorney. For use only with the Legal Privilege category.
